title: Budgets on the order of billions from TRW and Lockheed interviews
place_text: TRW and Lockheed Martin, United States

tellings.quote: It was on that order from my interviews with TRW and Loheed Martin people.

plain: Secret programmes tied to this subject are said to have run on budgets in the billions of dollars. A scientist named Eric W. Davis, introduced on the show as a Pentagon scientist, says he got that figure from people he interviewed at the defense contractors TRW and Lockheed Martin. "It was on that order from my interviews with TRW and Lockheed Martin people," he tells Michels, and if he is right, it would mean money on that scale has been spent out of public view.
